capabilities: Chat with supported coding agents in a sidebar or floating panel
Attach vault notes and files as context with @ mentions
Apply inline edits after reviewing word-level diffs
Run vault actions like frontmatter edits and link-aware file moves
Check provider readiness and install or update supported CLIs
extras: Free and MIT-licensed, but provider subscriptions and API charges apply; local-first with no telemetry; unsent drafts persist under .claudian/drafts/ and may sync; Antigravity provider is experimental and barred for consumer accounts; needs desktop Obsidian 1.7.2+; UI in 10 locales.
intentEvidence: Oh My Claudian began as a fork of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to drive external AI coding agents over a vault with attached context, reviewed diffs, and vault-aware actions.
